newsitem.title: USA: NY State Electric sets marketing charge.
newsitem.headline: NY State Electric sets marketing charge.

text.p: New York State Electric & Gas Corp said Friday it will take a $0.14 per share charge against third quarter earnings to write off its investment in EnerSoft Corp.
Spokeswoman Katherine Karlson said NYSEG is seeking a buyer for the subsidiary, which has had disappointing sales.

EnerSoft, formed in May 1993, develops and markets computer software and real-time information and trading systems for natural gas utilities, marketers and pipeline operators. EnerSoft developed Channel 4, a natural gas and pipeline capacity trading and information system.
Channel 4, EnerSoft's primary product, was made available for use on August 11, 1995. Although EnerSoft has been adding subscribers, sales have been disappointing, NYSEG said.
The utility said it believes the Channel 4 system may be best capitalized on by an established natural gas pipeline/marketer or electronic network company.
The company said it is assessing various exit strategies for EnerSoft and intends to exit the business by December 31.
